content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Vacancy 2027
content_sections.text: BHEL Electronics Division has announced 64 fixed-tenure vacancies across Project Engineer and Project Supervisor categories. Of these, eight vacancies are for Project Engineer (FTA Grade-II) and 56 are for Project Supervisor (FTA Grade-III), including the Hindi Translator position. The Traction Site Services function has the highest number of vacancies, with 45 posts. The BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 notification specifies eight position codes covering Engineering, Testing, Traction Site Services and Hindi Translation functions. Candidates should select the appropriate position code according to their educational qualifications and relevant experience. The BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 vacancies are distributed among Unreserved, EWS, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), SC and ST categories. The official notification provides the following position-wise reservation details. Reservation for Persons with Disabilities and Ex-Servicemen will be applicable according to Government directives. The advertised vacancy numbers are tentative and may change according to BHEL's requirements.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027?
content_sections.text: Before applying for BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, minimum marks, age limit and relevant work-experience requirements for their selected position code. Engineering Degree holders can apply for Project Engineer posts, while Diploma holders can apply for the prescribed Project Supervisor functions. The Hindi Translator post has separate language qualification requirements. All advertised positions require relevant post-qualification experience. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide, not confirmation of individual eligibility. Candidates should verify the qualifications, relevant experience and age conditions for their specific position code before applying.

rows.requirements: Full-Time Engineering Degree in the prescribed discipline.
Full-Time Engineering Diploma in the prescribed discipline.
Prescribed Bachelor's or Master's Degree involving Hindi and English.
60% for General, OBC and EWS; 50% for SC/ST in Engineering Degree or Diploma, as applicable.
32 Years for FTA01 to FTA06; 36 Years for FTA07 and FTA08, before applicable relaxation.
Minimum 1 or 2 Years of Relevant Post-Qualification Experience, Depending on Position.
Relevant professional experience, valid certificates and compliance with position-specific requirements.

content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Eligibility Criteria 2027
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 must meet the prescribed educational qualification, work experience and age requirements as on 1 November 2026. Eligibility differs across Quality, Factory Services, System Testing, Traction Site Services and Rajbhasha functions. Candidates should carefully match their qualifications and experience with the position code mentioned in the notification. BHEL has prescribed full-time Engineering Degree qualifications for Project Engineers and full-time Engineering Diploma qualifications for Project Supervisors. The minimum aggregate marks requirement is 60%, relaxed to 50% for SC and ST candidates. The Hindi Translator position has separate language-related degree requirements. The Engineering Degree or Diploma must be obtained from a recognised university or institution. Candidates should verify the exact discipline and aggregate-mark requirements in the official notification. Relevant work experience is mandatory for BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027. Candidates must have post-qualification experience in the technical or functional areas specified for their chosen position. Experience gained during apprenticeship training is excluded from the qualifying experience. Note: Candidates must have the relevant post-qualification experience as on 1 November 2026. Apprenticeship periods will not be counted. The official notification contains additional technical skill and desirable experience requirements for individual positions. The upper age limit for BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 varies according to the position code. For FTA01 to FTA06, the maximum age is 32 years. For FTA07 and FTA08, the maximum age is 36 years. Age will be calculated as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation for eligible reserved-category candidates. BHEL provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates according to the recruitment notification and applicable Government rules. Candidates claiming age relaxation must possess valid supporting documents. The J&K domicile provision applies to candidates meeting the specified residence-period conditions mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Application Fee 2027
content_sections.text: The BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 application processing fee is Rs.236 for General, OBC and EWS candidates. SC, ST and Persons with Disabilities are exempted from paying the fee. Eligible candidates must pay the fee through SBI Collect and enter the payment receipt or journal number in the online application form. Payment Mode: SBI Collect. The processing fee is non-refundable. Candidates required to pay the fee must enter the payment particulars in the online application and send the applicable payment receipt with the printed application. BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027: SBI Collect Fee Instructions

content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Salary 2027
content_sections.text: The BHEL FTA Salary 2027 varies according to the position and year of engagement. Project Engineers will receive Rs.84,000 per month in the first year and Rs.88,000 per month in the second year. Project Supervisors and Hindi Translators will receive Rs.45,000 per month in the first year and Rs.48,000 per month in the second year. Selected candidates will also be eligible for reimbursement of the premium for a Mediclaim Policy with coverage of Rs.5 lakh for self and eligible family members, including spouse and dependent children, according to the notification. Important: These positions are on a fixed-tenure basis for two years. The advertised remuneration is not a permanent BHEL employee pay scale, and the appointment does not create a right to regular employment.

content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Selection Process 2027
content_sections.text: The BHEL FTA Selection Process 2027 is based on personal interviews. The number of candidates invited for interview will depend on the number of eligible applicants for each position. Where the eligible applicants exceed the prescribed ratio, BHEL will use aggregate marks in the qualifying examination to restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for interview. BHEL will examine the submitted applications to determine whether candidates meet the prescribed educational qualification, experience, age and other eligibility conditions. If the number of eligible applicants for a post is up to ten times the number of vacancies, all eligible candidates will be considered for personal interview. If the number exceeds this ratio, candidates will be shortlisted based on aggregate marks in their qualifying Degree or Diploma examination, as applicable. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for personal interview. Interview details will be communicated individually through the email address provided during application. Candidates called for interview must produce the prescribed original documents and self-attested copies for verification. BHEL will verify educational qualifications, work experience, category certificates and other relevant documents. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for this FTA recruitment.

content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Apply Online 2027
content_sections.text: The BHEL FTA Apply Online 2027 process started on 23 November 2026 for 64 Project Engineer, Project Supervisor and Hindi Translator vacancies. Eligible candidates must complete the online application by 7 December 2026 through the BHEL Electronics Division recruitment portal. After online submission, candidates must print the completed application and send it with the applicable fee receipt by post within the prescribed deadline. BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027: Apply Online Candidates applying for BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 must complete both the online application and the required postal submission process. Follow the steps below. Important: Candidates should not rely on online submission alone. The official notification requires postal submission of the printed application form.

content_sections.heading: BHEL FTA Recruitment 2027 Postal Address
content_sections.text: After successfully submitting the online application, candidates must send the printed application form containing the unique acknowledgement number, along with the applicable fee receipt, to the following address. AGM (HR) Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited Electronics Division P. B. No. 2606 Mysore Road Bengaluru - 560026 The envelope should be superscribed with "Application for Appointment as Project Engineer/Supervisors on Fixed Tenure Basis - [FTA Code]" , replacing the bracketed field with the applicable position code. The normal last date for receipt of the printed application is 10 December 2026. The extended date of 12 December 2026 applies only to candidates from the specified far-flung areas listed in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for BHEL FTA Applicants
content_sections.text: Candidates should carefully follow the recruitment instructions issued by BHEL Electronics Division. The notification specifies important conditions regarding eligibility, work experience, application submission and contractual appointment. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must meet the prescribed qualifications and experience conditions as on 1 November 2026. Relevant post-qualification experience is mandatory for all advertised positions. Apprenticeship experience will not be counted towards the required professional experience. The online application must be completed by 7 December 2026. The printed application must reach BHEL by the applicable postal deadline. General, OBC and EWS candidates must pay the prescribed Rs.236 processing fee. Government, Semi-Government and PSU employees must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview stage. Eligible category reservations and age relaxations require valid supporting certificates. The appointment is purely on a fixed-tenure basis for two years. Selected candidates cannot claim permanent employment in BHEL solely on the basis of the appointment. Shortlisting and interview updates will be communicated through the registered email address and official website.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) Electronics Division, Bengaluru, for hiring engineering professionals and translators on a fixed tenure contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 64 vacancies announced under advertisement number FTA 02/2026 for various positions including Project Engineers, Project Supervisors, and Hindi Translator.

faq.question: Q3. What are the key posts offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification offers positions for Project Engineer (FTA Gr-II), Project Supervisor (FTA Gr-III), and Hindi Translator (FTA Gr-III) across multiple engineering disciplines and translation fields.

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process commences on 23 November 2026 and closes on 7 December 2026. Hard copies must also reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering with at least 60% marks along with relevant post-qualification industrial experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for BHEL Project Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for most project supervisor roles and up to 36 years for specific designations like FTA07 and FTA08 as of 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the monthly salary for Project Engineers?
faq.answer: Project Engineers receive Rs. 84,000 per month in the first year, which increases to Rs. 88,000 per month in the second year, along with health insurance benefits.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, and Persons with Disability categories are completely exempted from paying the application fee of Rs. 236/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting candidates based on qualifying examination marks when applicant volume is high, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the printed application form be sent by post?
faq.answer: The printed online application form along with fee receipt and documents must be sent by post to AGM (HR), Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited, Electronics Division, Bengaluru.
